payload.name: Reciprocity Nudge Boomerang Effect
payload.fact: Reciprocity-based nudge messages can produce a negative (boomerang) effect on tax compliance behavior compared to control conditions.
payload.boundary: Observed in field experiments with small business owners in South Africa.
